conditions.host: Dedicated Forge server with jem_security enabled and the matching required client companion

change.summary: Add server-authoritative Creative provenance, command and game-mode audit, outgoing-chunk Anti-Xray, action validation and bounded client attestation

modifiers.before: The initial chunk packet exposes every real ore block state to resource packs and client render mods
modifiers.after: Fully enclosed forge:ores blocks and Ancient Debris are encoded as a neighboring solid filler until server-observed exposure, without changing the authoritative world block
modifiers.notes: Exposed ores remain visible. The server reveals adjacent real states after block removal

modifiers.before: No JEM-owned durable correlation between a Creative slot mutation and the later stack
modifiers.after: Creative-created stacks receive a provenance UUID and per-player JSONL transitions cover creation, clearing, count reduction, inventory exit, drop, pickup, use, placement and container closure through one bounded daemon writer that never blocks the game thread

modifiers.before: No matching JEM security channel or bounded declared-mod/resource-pack report
modifiers.after: Matching client/server protocol is required; exact configured banned mod IDs and suspicious enabled pack tokens are rejected while jem_freecam remains allowed
An operator may request a bounded sanitized latest.log tail, but transmission starts only after an explicit player click and removes user paths, likely secrets and IP addresses

modifiers.before: Content-matched Xray selection was blocked locally but produced no immediate server-console event until a committed pack was attested
modifiers.after: The matching client reports the first blocked selection per resource-pack screen state through a bounded rate-limited packet. The server appends resource_pack_enable_attempt to the UUID audit and emits [JEM Security] <player> attempted to enable Xray pack <pack> without treating the forgeable client report as proof

rationale.purpose: Prevent hidden-ore disclosure and unauthorized remote interactions while preserving auditable Creative administration without FCW AntiCheat render integration
rationale.user_requested: Create JEM Security, keep test jem unchanged, allow JEM Freecam, block third-party through-block freecam and xray advantages, and track Creative and suspicious actions
rationale.codex_choices: Use outgoing chunk encoding instead of renderer hooks, exact configurable client IDs plus server authority, provenance NBT for Creative stacks, JSONL journals and consent-only sanitized log transfer

introduced.summary: Add the standalone source and production artifact without installing it into test jem or runtime distributions

history.summary: Add server-authoritative audit, Anti-Xray and matching client attestation while explicitly allowing jem_freecam
Install the matching artifact in the ordinary local Server and ManagedPack, publish native generation 105 and load the dedicated runtime before client application
Replace reliance on the unobserved client LoggingIn report with a server-initiated PLAY-channel challenge and client response while preserving the fail-closed deadline
Answer the server challenge from Forge's network consumer using the bounded client-login snapshot so JEI render-thread initialization cannot consume the fail-closed deadline
Permit only jem_security:main through the ServerLogin pre-auth payload gate so the required attestation reaches its server-owned validator
Connect test jem to the ordinary local dedicated server, enter the world and observe client_attested before and beyond the fail-closed deadline

Inspect selected file resource packs for Xray model-tree and selective-geometry signatures, disable resource-pack confirmation while detected, and report the same content verdict during client attestation
Load the final JEM Security 1.0.3 artifact on the ordinary local server, publish native generation 110 and apply the exact reviewed delta to the closed test jem profile
Report a blocked content-matched resource-pack selection immediately to the dedicated server audit and console with bounded client/server transport and server-side rate limiting
Cache the client attestation during Forge LoggingIn without sending through a possibly absent ClientPacketListener, then answer only the existing server challenge on the established PLAY channel

relations: Authoritative LevelChunk -> filtered outgoing section copy -> client chunk only
Creative slot packet -> provenance tag -> server transition journal
Declared client mods and packs -> bounded attestation -> exact configured admission decision
Selected file resource-pack contents -> bounded model signature scan -> disabled confirmation and attested server rejection
Blocked selection transition -> bounded client report -> rate-limited UUID audit and clear server-console warning
Administrator request -> player consent -> client-side redaction -> bounded server file
notes: JEM Freecam remains allowed and retains its own collision and interaction guards
No Embeddium, Oculus or renderer class is referenced
The module is inactive on integrated servers
Client attestation is forgeable and is never treated as sole proof
Renaming a ZIP or merging the inspected Xray model code into another file resource pack does not change its content verdict

Five Whys: disconnect -> server deadline expired -> ServerLogin discarded the client custom payload before JEM Security -> jem_security:main was absent from the pre-auth allowlist -> the security and authentication modules lacked an explicit pre-auth channel contract
Local acceptance verified on 2026-10-29: test jem entered 127.0.0.1:31604, the server audit recorded client_attested for JEM Security 1.0.2, and the connection remained active beyond the deadline
unresolved: Anti-Xray packet results and gameplay acceptance remain unobserved
A hostile modified client can still forge or remove client-side scanning, so server-owned Anti-Xray remains authoritative
Native generation 110 installed JEM Security 1.0.3 in test jem with content token 6d7a4cd6949925f239b2c2f64fb8665cd15d87b3 and no pending transaction
